visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Use Arrays.copyOf and Arrays.toString
visualizerParams.problemDescription: An array is copied element by element and printed by building the text with a loop. Use Arrays.copyOf and Arrays.toString. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The standard library already has well-tested helpers for the most common array jobs. Using them is shorter, faster and less likely to contain an off-by-one error.
